verses.geez:
ወአንጐርጐረ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ በእኪት ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሰምዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተምዐ ፡ መዐተ ፡ ወነደደ ፡ እሳት
                  ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወበልዐት ፡ አሐደ ፡ ኅብረ ፡ እምነ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And the people murmured sinfully before the Lord; and the Lord heard them and was very angry; and fire was kindled among them from the Lord, and devoured a part of the camp.

translations.lxx: And the people murmured sinfully before the Lord; and the Lord heard them and was very angry; and fire was kindled among them from the Lord, and devoured a part of the camp.
translations.kjv: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
translations.ron: Poporul însă începu să cârtească în auzul Domnului, iar Domnul auzind, se aprinse mânia Lui, izbucni între ei foc de la Domnul şi începu a mistui marginile taberei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς γογγύζων πονηρὰ ἔναντι Κυρίου· καὶ ἤκουσε Κύριος, καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ· καὶ ἐξεκαύθη ἐν αὐτοῖς πῦρ παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ κατέφαγε μέρος τι τῆς παρεμβολῆς.

verses.geez: ወጸርሐ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወጸለየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኀደገት ፡ እሳት ።
verses.translation: And the people cried to Moses: and Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire was quenched.

translations.lxx: And the people cried to Moses: and Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire was quenched.
translations.kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
translations.ron: Atunci a strigat poporul către Moise, iar Moise s-a rugat Domnului şi a încetat focul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκέκραξεν ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Μωυσῆν· καὶ ηὔξατο Μωυσῆς πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ ἐκόπασε τὸ πῦρ.

verses.geez: ወተሰምየ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ውዕየት ፡ እስመ ፡ ነደደት ፡ እሳት ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the name of that place was called Burning; for a fire was kindled among them from the Lord.

translations.lxx: And the name of that place was called Burning; for a fire was kindled among them from the Lord.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
translations.ron: De aceea s-a numit locul acela: Tabeera, adică ardere, căci acolo a fost aprins între ei focul de la Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου, Ἐμπυρισμός· ὅτι ἐξεκαύθη ἐν αὐτοῖς παρὰ Κυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወእለ ፡ ተደመሩሂ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ፈተዉ ፡ ፍትወተ ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ወበከዩ ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤልኒ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ መኑ ፡
                  ያበልዐነ ፡ ሥጋ ።
verses.translation: And the mixed multitude among them lusted exceedingly; and they and the children of Israel sat down and wept and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

translations.lxx: And the mixed multitude among them lusted exceedingly; and they and the children of Israel sat down and wept and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
translations.kjv: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
translations.ron: Străinii, dintre ei, începură să-şi arate poftele şi şedeau cu ei şi fiii lui Israel şi plângeau, zicând: "Cine ne va hrăni cu carne?
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ ἐπίμικτος ὁ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐπεθύμησεν ἐπιθυμίαν· καὶ καθίσαντες ἔκλαιον καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ εἶπαν, τίς ἡμᾶς ψωμιεῖ κρέα;

verses.geez:
ተዘከርነ ፡ ዝክተ ፡ ዓሣተ ፡ ዘንበልዕ ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በከንቱ ፡ ወቍሳያቲሁ ፡ ወመልጰጶን ፡ ወስጕርደ ፡ ወበጸለ
                  ፡ ወሶመተ ።
verses.translation: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt freely; and the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the garlic, and the onions.

translations.lxx: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt freely; and the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the garlic, and the onions.
translations.kjv: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
translations.ron: Căci ne aducem aminte de peştele, pe care-l mâncam în Egipt în dar, de castraveţi şi de pepeni, de ceapă, de praz şi de usturoi;
translations.grk: Ἐμνήσθημεν τοὺς ἰχθύας, οὓς ἠσθίομεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ δωρεὰν. καὶ τοὺς σικύας, καὶ τοὺς πέπονας, καὶ τὰ πράσα, καὶ τὰ κρόμμυα, καὶ τὰ σκόρδα.

verses.geez: ወይአዜሰ ፡ የብሰት ፡ ነፍስነ ፡ ዘአልብነ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ ዘንሬኢ ፡ እንበለ ፡ መና ።
verses.translation: But now our soul is dried up; our eyes turn to nothing but to the manna.

translations.lxx: But now our soul is dried up; our eyes turn to nothing but to the manna.
translations.kjv: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
translations.ron: Acum însă sufletul nostru tânjeşte; nimic nu mai este înaintea ochilor noştri decât numai mana".
translations.grk: Νυνὶ δὲ ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν κατάξηρος· οὐδὲν πλὴν εἰς τὸ μάννα οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν.

verses.geez: ወመናሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ተቅዳ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወርእየቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ርእየተ ፡ በረድ ።
verses.translation: And the manna is as coriander seed, and the appearance of it the appearance of hoarfrost.

translations.lxx: And the manna is as coriander seed, and the appearance of it the appearance of hoarfrost.
translations.kjv: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
translations.ron: Iar mana era ca sămânţa de coriandru şi înfăţişarea ei era ca înfăţişarea cristalului.
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ μάννα ὡσεὶ σπέρμα κορίου ἐστὶ, καὶ τὸ εἶδος αὐτοῦ εἶδος κρυστάλλου.

verses.geez:
ወየሐውሩ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወይኤልዱ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወየሐርጽዎ ፡ በማሕረጽ ፡ ወይዴቅቅዎ ፡ በመድቀቅት ፡ ወያበስልዎ ፡ በመቅጹት ፡
                  ወይገብርዎ ፡ ዳፍንተኒ ፡ ወጣዕሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጣዕመ ፡ መዓር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቅብእ ።
verses.translation: And the people went through the field, and gathered, and ground it in the mill, or pounded it in a mortar, and baked it in a pan, and made cakes of it; and the sweetness of it was as the taste of wafer made with oil.

translations.lxx: And the people went through the field, and gathered, and ground it in the mill, or pounded it in a mortar, and baked it in a pan, and made cakes of it; and the sweetness of it was as the taste of wafer made with oil.
translations.kjv: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
translations.ron: Poporul se ducea şi o aduna, o râşneau în râşniţe sau o pisau în piuă, o fierbeau în căldări şi făceau din ea turte; iar gustul ei era ca gustul turtelor cu untdelemn.
translations.grk: Καὶ διεπορεύετο ὁ λαὸς, καὶ συνέλεγον, καὶ ἤληθον αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ μύλῳ, καὶ ἔτριβον ἐν τῇ θυΐᾳ, καὶ ἥψουν αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ χύτρᾳ, καὶ ἐποίουν αὐτὸ ἐνκρυφίας· καὶ ἦν ἡ ἡδονὴ αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ γεῦμα ἐγκρὶς ἐξ ἐλαίου.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ይወርድ ፡ ጠል ፡ ዲበ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ይወርድ ፡ መናሂ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And when the dew came upon the camp by night, the manna came down upon it.

translations.lxx: And when the dew came upon the camp by night, the manna came down upon it.
translations.kjv: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
translations.ron: Când cădea noaptea roua pe tabără, atunci cădea peste ea şi mana.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὅταν κατέβη ἡ δρόσος ἐπὶ τὴν παρεμβολὴν νυκτὸς, κατέβαινε τὸ μάννα ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይበክዩ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኆኅቱ ፡ ወተምዕዐ ፡ መዐተ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወበቅድመ ፡ ሙሴኒ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ኮነ ።
verses.translation: And Moses heard them weeping by their families, every one in his door: and the Lord was very angry; and the thing was evil in the sight of Moses.

translations.lxx: And Moses heard them weeping by their families, every one in his door: and the Lord was very angry; and the thing was evil in the sight of Moses.
translations.kjv: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
translations.ron: Moise însă auzea cum plângea fiecare prin familiile sale şi la uşa cortului său, şi s-a aprins tare mânia Domnului şi s-a mâhnit Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσε Μωυσῆς κλαίοντων αὐτῶν κατά δήμους αὐτῶν, ἕκαστον ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ Κύριος σφόδρα· καὶ ἔναντι Μωυσῆ ἦν πονηρόν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለምንት ፡ አሕሠምከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቍልዔከ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ኢረከብኩ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜከ
                  ፡ ከመ ፡ ታግብእ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ መንሴቶ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to the Lord, Why hast thou afflicted thy servant, and why have I not found grace in thy sight, that thou shouldest lay the weight of this people upon me?

translations.lxx: And Moses said to the Lord, Why hast thou afflicted thy servant, and why have I not found grace in thy sight, that thou shouldest lay the weight of this people upon me?
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Moise către Domnul: "De ce întristezi pe robul Tău şi de ce oare n-am aflat milă înaintea ochilor Tăi, căci ai pus asupra mea sarcina a tot poporul acesta?
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς πρὸς Κύριον, ἱνατί ἐκάκωσας τὸν θεράποντά σου, καὶ διατί οὐχ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐναντίον σου, ἐπιθεῖναι τὴν ὁρμὴν τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου ἐπʼ ἐμέ;

verses.geez:
ቦኑ ፡ አነ ፡ ፀነስክዎሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወቦኑ ፡ አነ ፡ ወለድክዎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትበለኒ ፡ ንሥኦሙ ፡ ውስተ
                  ፡ ሕፅንከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይነሥእዎ ፡ ለዘ ፡ የሐፅኑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐልከ ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ ።
verses.translation: Have I conceived all this people, or have I born them? that thou sayest to me, Take them into thy bosom, as a nurse would take her suckling, into the land which thou swarest to their fathers?

translations.lxx: Have I conceived all this people, or have I born them? that thou sayest to me, Take them into thy bosom, as a nurse would take her suckling, into the land which thou swarest to their fathers?
translations.kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
translations.ron: Oare eu am zămislit tot poporul acesta şi oare eu l-am născut, de-mi zici: Ia-l în sânul tău, cum ia doica pe copil, şi-l du în pământul pe care cu jurământ l-am făgăduit părinţilor lui?
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐγὼ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβον πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον, ἢ ἐγὼ ἔτεκον αὐτούς; ὅτι λέγεις μοι, λάβε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν κόλπον σου, ὡσεὶ ἄραι τιθηνὸς τὸν θηλάζοντα, εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσας τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν;

verses.geez:
እምአይቴ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ዘእሁብ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ይበክዩ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወይብሉኒ ፡ ሀበነ
                  ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንብላዕ ።
verses.translation: Whence have I flesh to give to all this people? for they weep to me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

translations.lxx: Whence have I flesh to give to all this people? for they weep to me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
translations.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
translations.ron: De unde să iau şi să dau eu carne la tot poporul acesta? Căci plâng înaintea mea şi. zic: Dă-ne carne să mâncăm!
translations.grk: Πόθεν μοι κρέα, δοῦναι παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ; ὅτι κλαίουσιν ἐπʼ ἐμοὶ, λέγοντες, δὸς ἡμῖν κρέα, ἵνα φάγωμεν.

verses.geez: ወኢይክል ፡ አነ ፡ ባሕቲትየ ፡ ዐቂቦቶ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይከብደኒ ።
verses.translation: I shall not be able to bear this people alone, for this thing is too heavy for me.

translations.lxx: I shall not be able to bear this people alone, for this thing is too heavy for me.
translations.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
translations.ron: Eu singur nu voi putea să duc tot poporul acesta, că acest lucru este greu pentru mine.
translations.grk: Οὐ δυνήσομαι ἐγὼ μόνος φέρειν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον, ὅτι βαρύτερόν μοι ἐστὶ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο.

verses.geez:
ወለእመሰ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ትሬስየኒ ፡ ቀቲለ ፡ ቅትለኒ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ረብብኩ ፡ ምሕረተ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይርአያ ፡
                  ለእኪትየ ።
verses.translation: And if thou doest thus to me, slay me utterly, if I have found favour with thee, that I may not see my affliction.

translations.lxx: And if thou doest thus to me, slay me utterly, if I have found favour with thee, that I may not see my affliction.
translations.kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
translations.ron: Dacă faci aşa cu mine, atunci mai bine omoară-mă, de am aflat milă înaintea ochilor Tăi, ca să nu mai văd necazul acesta".
translations.grk: Εἰ δʼ οὕτω σὺ ποιεῖς μοι, ἀπόκτεινόν με ἀναιρέσει, εἰ εὕρηκα ἔλεος παρὰ σοὶ, ἵνα μὴ ἴδω τὴν κάκωσίν μου.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ አስተጋብእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ፸ብእሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አዕሩጊሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እለ
                  ፡ ታአምር ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ከመ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሊቃናቱ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ወጸሐፍቶሙኒ ፡ ወታበውኦሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡
                  ወይቁሙ ፡ ህየ ፡ ምስሌከ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Gather me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom thou thyself knowest that they are the elders of the people, and their scribes; and thou shalt bring them to the tabernacle of witness, and they shall stand there with thee.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Gather me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom thou thyself knowest that they are the elders of the people, and their scribes; and thou shalt bring them to the tabernacle of witness, and they shall stand there with thee.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
translations.ron: Atunci Domnul a zis către Moise: "Adună-Mi şaptezeci de bărbaţi, dintre bătrânii lui Israel, pe care-i ştii tu că sunt căpetenii poporului şi supraveghetorii lui, şi du-i la cortul adunării, ca să stea cu tine acolo.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆς, συνάγαγέ μοι ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Ἰσραήλ, οὓς αὐτὸς σὺ οἶδας, ὅτι οὗτοί εἰσι πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ γραμματεῖς αὐτῶς· καὶ ἄξεις αὐτοὺς πρὸς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ στήσονται ἐκεῖ μετὰ σοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወእወርድ ፡ ወእትናገር ፡ በህየ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወእነሥእ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ዘላዕሌከ ፡ ወኣነብር ፡ ዲቤሆሙ ፡
                  ወይጸውሩ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ክበዶሙ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወኢትሥራሕ ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And I will go down, and speak there with thee; and I will take of the spirit that is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear together with thee the burden of the people, and thou shalt not bear them alone.

translations.lxx: And I will go down, and speak there with thee; and I will take of the spirit that is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear together with thee the burden of the people, and thou shalt not bear them alone.
translations.kjv: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
translations.ron: Că Mă voi pogorî acolo şi voi vorbi cu tine şi voi lua din duhul care este peste tine şi voi pune peste ei ca să ducă ei cu tine sarcina poporului şi să nu o duci numai tu singur.
translations.grk: Καὶ καταβήσομαι, καὶ λαλήσω ἐκεῖ μετὰ σοῦ· καὶ ἀφελῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἐπὶ σοὶ, καὶ ἐπιθήσω ἐπʼ αὐτούς· καὶ συναντιλήψονται μετὰ σοῦ τὴν ὁρμὴν τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ οὐκ οἴσεις αὐτὸς σὺ μόνος.

verses.geez:
ወለሕዝብኒ ፡ ትብሎሙ ፡ ያንጽሑ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ለጌሠም ፡ ወትበልዑ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ እስመ ፡ በከይክሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  እንዘ ፡ ትብሉ ፡ መኑ ፡ ያበልዐነ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይኄይሰነ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወይሁበክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ትብልዑ ፡
                  ሥጋ ፡ ወተበልዑ ፡ ሥጋ ።
verses.translation: And to the people thou shalt say, Purify yourselves for the morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye wept before the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: and the Lord shall allow you to eat flesh, and ye shall eat flesh.

translations.lxx: And to the people thou shalt say, Purify yourselves for the morrow, and ye shall eat flesh; for ye wept before the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: and the Lord shall allow you to eat flesh, and ye shall eat flesh.
translations.kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
translations.ron: Iar poporului spune-i: Să vă curăţiţi pentru ziua de mâine şi veţi avea carne, deoarece aţi plâns în auzul Domnului şi aţi zis: Cine ne va hrăni cu carne? Că ne era bine în Egipt; că are să vă dea Domnul carne să mâncaţi şi veţi mânca;
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ λαῷ ἐρεῖς, ἁγνίσασθε εἰς αὔριον, καὶ φάγεσθε κρέα· ὅτι ἐκλαύσατε ἔναντι Κυρίου, λέγοντες, τίς ἡμᾶς ψωμιεῖ κρέα; ὅτι καλὸν ἡμῖν ἐστιν ἐν Αἰγυπτῳ· καὶ δώσει Κύριος ὑμῖν φαγεῖν κρέα, καὶ φάγεσθε κρέα.

verses.geez:
አኮ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ዘትበልዑ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ሰኑየ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ኀሙሰ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ዐሡረ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ዕሥራ ፡
                  መዋዕለ ፤
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days;

translations.lxx: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days;
translations.kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
translations.ron: Şi veţi mânca nu numai o zi, nici numai două sau cinci zile, nici numai zece sau douăzeci de zile,
translations.grk: Οὐχ ἡμέραν μίαν φάγεσθε, οὐ δὲ δύο, οὐ δὲ πέντε ἡμέρας, οὐ δὲ δέκα ἡμέρας, οὐ δὲ εἴκοσι ἡμέρας,

verses.geez:
አላ ፡ እስከ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ትበልዕዎ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አእናፋቲክሙ ፡ ወይከውነክሙ ፡ ሕምዘ ፡
                  እስመ ፡ ክህድክምዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስቴትክሙ ፡ ወበከይክሙ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብሉ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ለነ ፡
                  አውፃእከነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ።
verses.translation: ye shall eat for a full month, until the flesh come out at your nostrils; and it shall be nausea to you, because ye disobeyed the Lord, who is among you, and wept before him, saying, What had we to do to come out of Egypt?

translations.lxx: ye shall eat for a full month, until the flesh come out at your nostrils; and it shall be nausea to you, because ye disobeyed the Lord, who is among you, and wept before him, saying, What had we to do to come out of Egypt?
translations.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
translations.ron: Ci o lună întreagă veţi mânca până vă va da pe nas şi vă veţi scârbi de ea, pentru că aţi dispreţuit pe Domnul, Care este între voi, şi v-aţi plâns înaintea Lui şi aţi zis: La ce trebuia să ieşim noi din Egipt?"
translations.grk: ἕως μηνὸς ἡμερῶν φάγεσθε, ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τῶν μυκτήρων ὑμῶν· καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν εἰς χολέραν, ὅτι ἠπειθήσατε Κυρίῳ, ὅς ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ ἐκλαύσατε ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ, λέγοντες, ἱνατί ἡμῖν ἐξελθεῖν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου;

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ስሳ ፡ እልፍ ፡ አጋር ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፡ ሀለውኩ ፡ [ወአንተ ፡ ትቤለኒ ፡ እሁቦሙ ፡ ሥጋ
                  ፡] ወይበልዑ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ወርኅ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said, The people among whom I am are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou saidst, I will give them flesh to eat, and they shall eat a whole month.

translations.lxx: And Moses said, The people among whom I am are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou saidst, I will give them flesh to eat, and they shall eat a whole month.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Moise: "În poporul acesta, în care mă aflu, sunt şase sute de mii de pedeştri şi Tu zici: Am să le dau carne să mănânce şi vor mânca o lună de zile!
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς, ἑξακόσιαι χιλιάδες πεζῶν ὁ λαὸς, ἐν οἷς εἰμι ἐν αὐτοῖς· καὶ σὺ εἶπας, κρέα δώσω αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν, καὶ φάγονται μῆνα ἡμερῶν·

verses.geez:
ቦኑ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ወአልህምት ፡ ይጠባኅ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ አው ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዓሣተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ይትጋባእ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይእከሎሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: Shall sheep and oxen be slain for them, and shall it suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, and shall it suffice them?

translations.lxx: Shall sheep and oxen be slain for them, and shall it suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, and shall it suffice them?
translations.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
translations.ron: Li se vor tăia, oare, toate oile şi toţi boii, ca să le ajungă? Sau tot peştele mării li se va aduna, ca să-i îndestuleze?"
translations.grk: Μὴ πρόβατα καὶ βόες σφαγήσονται αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἀρκέσει αὐτοῖς; ἢ πᾶν τὸ ὄψος τῆς θαλάσσης συναχθήσεται αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἀρκέσει αὐτοῖς;

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ኢትክል ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ናሁ ፡ ትሬኢ ፡ እመ ፡ ትረክቦ ፡ ለቃልየ
                  ፡ ወእመ ፡ አልቦ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Shall not the hand of the Lord be fully sufficient? now shalt thou know whether my word shall come to pass to thee or not.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Shall not the hand of the Lord be fully sufficient? now shalt thou know whether my word shall come to pass to thee or not.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
translations.ron: Zis-a Domnul către Moise: "Dar, oare, mâna Domnului e scurtă? Acum vei vedea de se va împlini sau nu cuvântul Meu".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, μὴ χεὶρ Κυρίου οὐκ ἐξαρκέσει; ἤδη γνώσῃ εἰ ἐπικαταλήμψεταί σε ὁ λόγος μου ἢ οὔ.

verses.geez:
ወወፅአ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወነገሮሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአስተጋብአ ፡ ፸ብእሴ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አዕሩጊሆሙ ፡
                  ለሕዝብ ፡ ወአቀሞሙ ፡ አውደ ፡ ደብተራ ።
verses.translation: And Moses went out, and spoke the words of the Lord to the people; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and he set them round about the tabernacle.

translations.lxx: And Moses went out, and spoke the words of the Lord to the people; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and he set them round about the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
translations.ron: Atunci a ieşit Moise şi a spus poporului cuvintele Domnului, a adunat şaptezeci de bărbaţi dintre bătrânii poporului şi i-a pus împrejurul cortului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθε Μωυσῆς, καὶ ἐλάλησε πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τὰ ῥήματα Κυρίου· καὶ συνήγαγεν ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸς κύκλῳ τῆς σκηνῆς.

verses.geez:
ወወረደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በደመና ፡ ወተናገሮ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ዘላዕሌሁ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ፸ብእሲ
                  ፡ ሊቃናት ፡ ወእምዘ ፡ አዕረፈ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ተነበዩ ፡ ወኢተወሰኩ ፡ እንከ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy men that were elders; and when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied and ceased.

translations.lxx: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and put it upon the seventy men that were elders; and when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied and ceased.
translations.kjv: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
translations.ron: Şi S-a pogorât Domnul în nor şi a vorbit cu el; şi a luat din duhul care era peste el şi a pus peste cei şaptezeci de bărbaţi căpetenii. Îndată însă cum a odihnit duhul peste ei, au început a prooroci, dar apoi au încetat.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβη Κύριος ἐν νεφέλῃ, καὶ ἐλάλησε πρὸς αὐτόν· καὶ παρείλατο ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἑβδομήκοντα ἄνδρας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους· ὡς δὲ ἐπανεπαύσατο πνεῦμα ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐπροφήτευσαν, καὶ οὐκ ἔτι προσέθεντο.

verses.geez:
ወተረፉ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ዕደው ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለአሐዱ ፡ ኤልዳድ ፡ ወሞዳድ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ ወአዕረፈ ፡
                  ላዕሌሆሙኒ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ወእሙንቱኒ ፡ ተጽሕፉ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ወኢመጽኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ወተነበዩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት
                  ።
verses.translation: And there were two men left in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Modad; and the spirit rested upon them, and these were of the number of them that were enrolled, but they did not come to the tabernacle; and they prophesied in the camp.

translations.lxx: And there were two men left in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Modad; and the spirit rested upon them, and these were of the number of them that were enrolled, but they did not come to the tabernacle; and they prophesied in the camp.
translations.kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
translations.ron: Doi dintre bărbaţi însă au rămas în tabără: pe unul îl chema Eldad şi pe celălalt îl chema Medad. Şi a odihnit şi peste ei duhul, căci erau din cei înscrişi, dar nu veniseră la cort, şi au proorocit şi ei acolo în tabără.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατελείφθησαν δύο ἄνδρες ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ, ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ Ἑλδὰδ, καὶ ὄνομα τῷ δευτέρῳ Μωδάδ· καὶ ἐπανεπαύσατο ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς πνεῦμα· καὶ οὗτοι ἦσαν τῶν καταγεγραμμένων, καὶ οὐκ ἦλθον πρὸς τὴν σκηνήν· καὶ ἐπροφήτευσαν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ.

verses.geez: ወሮጸ ፡ ወሬዛ ፡ ወዜነዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ኤልዳድ ፡ ወሞዳድ ፡ ተነበዩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And a young man ran and told Moses, and spoke, saying, Eldad and Modad prophesy in the camp.

translations.lxx: And a young man ran and told Moses, and spoke, saying, Eldad and Modad prophesy in the camp.
translations.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
translations.ron: Atunci a alergat un tânăr şi a spus lui Moise, zicând: "Eldad şi Medad proorocesc în tabără".
translations.grk: Καὶ προσδραμὼν ὁ νεανίσκος, ἀπήγγειλε Μωυσῇ· καὶ εἶπε, λέγων, Ἑλδὰδ καὶ Μωδὰδ προφητεύουσιν ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ዘነዌ ፡ ዘይቀውም ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ኅሩዩ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ [ሙሴ ፡] ክልኦሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Naue, who attended on Moses, the chosen one, said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

translations.lxx: And Joshua the son of Naue, who attended on Moses, the chosen one, said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
translations.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
translations.ron: Şi răspunzând, Iosua, fiul lui Navi, slujitorul lui Moise, unul din aleşii lui, a zis: "Domnul meu Moise, opreşte-i!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυὴ, ὁ παρεστηκὼς Μωυσῇ, ὁ ἐκλεκτὸς, εἶπε, κύριε Μωυσῆ, κώλυσον αὐτούς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ አንተኑ ፡ ትቀንእ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወመኑ ፡ እምወሀበኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትነበይ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
                  ፡ ሶበ ፡ ወሀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መንፈሶ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to him, Art thou jealous on my account? and would that all the Lord's people were prophets; whenever the Lord shall put his spirit upon them.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to him, Art thou jealous on my account? and would that all the Lord's people were prophets; whenever the Lord shall put his spirit upon them.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD’s people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
translations.ron: Moise însă i-a zis: "Nu cumva eşti gelos pe mine? O, de ar fi toţi prooroci în poporul Domnului şi de ar trimite Domnul duhul Său peste ei!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς αὐτῷ, μὴ ζηλοῖς ἐμέ; καὶ τίς δῴη πάντα τὸν λαὸν Κυρίου προφήτας, ὅταν δῷ Κύριος τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτούς;

verses.geez: ወገብአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወአዕሩጊሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And Moses departed into the camp, himself and the elders of Israel.

translations.lxx: And Moses departed into the camp, himself and the elders of Israel.
translations.kjv: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
translations.ron: Apoi s-a întors Moise în tabără împreună cu bătrânii lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπῆλθε Μωυσῆς εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወወፅአ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወዐደወ ፡ ፍርፍርት ፡ እምነ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወወረዶ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡
                  እስከ ፡ ምሕዋረ ፡ ዕለት ፡ እምነ ፡ አውደ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ እምለፌ ፡ ወእምለፌ ፡ ወተወጥሐ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ እመት ፡ መልዕልተ ፡
                  ምድር ።
verses.translation: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails over from the sea; and it brought them down upon the camp a day's journey on this side, and a day's journey on that side, round about the camp, as it were two cubits from the earth.

translations.lxx: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails over from the sea; and it brought them down upon the camp a day's journey on this side, and a day's journey on that side, round about the camp, as it were two cubits from the earth.
translations.kjv: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a stârnit vânt de la Domnul, a adus prepeliţe dinspre mare şi le-a presărat împrejurul taberei cale de o zi într-o parte şi cale de o zi în cealaltă parte împrejurul taberei, strat gros aproape de doi coţi de la pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ πνεῦμα ἐξῆλθε παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ ἐξεπέρασεν ὀρτυγομήτραν ἀπὸ τῆς θαλάσσης· καὶ ἐπέβαλεν ἐπὶ τὴν παρεμβολὴν ὁδὸν ἡμέρας ἐντεῦθεν, καὶ ὁδὸν ἡμέρας ἐντεῦθεν, κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς, ὡσεὶ δίπηχυ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወተንሥአ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እንተ ፡ በሳኒታ ፡ ወአለዱ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ፍርፍርተ
                  ፡ ወዘአውሐዱ ፡ አልዶ ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ በቆ[ሮ]ስ ፡ ወሰጥሑ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወአይበሱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አውደ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the people rose up all the day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered quails; he that gathered least, gathered ten measures; and they refreshed themselves round about the camp.

translations.lxx: And the people rose up all the day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered quails; he that gathered least, gathered ten measures; and they refreshed themselves round about the camp.
translations.kjv: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a sculat poporul şi toată ziua şi toată noaptea aceea şi toată ziua următoare au adunat prepeliţe; şi cine a adunat puţin, tot a adunat zece coşuri şi le-au întins împrejurul taberei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ λαὸς ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα, καὶ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐπαύριον, καὶ συνήγαγον τὴν ὀρτυγομήτραν· ὁ τὸ ὀλίγον, συνήγαγε δέκα κόρους· καὶ ἔψυξαν ἑαυτοῖς ψυγμοὺς κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς.

verses.geez:
ወእንዘ ፡ ሀለወ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፅረሲሆሙ ፡ እንበለ ፡ ያኅልቅዎ ፡ ተምዕዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡
                  ወቀተሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: The flesh was yet between their teeth, before it failed, when the Lord was wroth with the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.

translations.lxx: The flesh was yet between their teeth, before it failed, when the Lord was wroth with the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.
translations.kjv: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
translations.ron: Dar carnea era încă în gura lor şi nu isprăviseră încă de mâncat, când se aprinse mânia Domnului asupra poporului, şi a lovit Domnul poporul cu bătaie foarte mare.
translations.grk: Τὰ κρέα ἔτι ἦν ἐν τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν αὐτῶν πρινὴ ἐκλείπειν, καὶ Κύριος ἐθυμώθη εἰς τὸν λαὸν, καὶ ἐπάταξε Κύριος τὸν λαὸν πληγὴν μεγάλην σφόδρα.

verses.geez: ወተሰምየ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ተዝካረ ፡ ፍትወት ፡ እስመ ፡ ቀበርዎሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ፈተዉ ።
verses.translation: And the name of that place was called the Graves of Lust; for there they buried the people that lusted.

translations.lxx: And the name of that place was called the Graves of Lust; for there they buried the people that lusted.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
translations.ron: Şi s-a pus numele locului aceluia: Chibrot-Hataava, adică mormintele poftei, căci acolo au îngropat pe poporul cel aprins de poftă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου, Μνήματα τῆς ἐπιθυμίας· ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐπιθυμητήν.

verses.geez: ወግዕዘ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እምነ ፡ ተዝካረ ፡ ፍትወት ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሴሮት ፡ [ወነበሩ ፡ በአሴሮት ፡]፡
verses.translation: The people departed from the Graves of Lust to Aseroth; and the people halted at Aseroth.

translations.lxx: The people departed from the Graves of Lust to Aseroth; and the people halted at Aseroth.
translations.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
translations.ron: Apoi a plecat poporul din Chibrot-Hataava la Haşerot şi s-a oprit în Haşerot.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ Μνημάτων ἐπιθυμίας ἐξῇρεν ὁ λαὸς εἰς Ἀσηρώθ· καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ λαὸς ἐν Ἀσηρώθ.
